```{r}
# --- Load data ---
covariate_stack <- rast("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m.tif")

# if you still need the sample coordinates / soil values from csv:
soil_SP_raw <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_SP.csv")
soil_C_raw  <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_C.csv")

# Load carbon + nitrogen dataset
soil_with_CN <- read_csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/carbon/soil_data_with_CN.csv") %>%
  rename(
    c = leco_carbon_average,
    n = leco_nitrogen_average
  )

# Split by sampling type
SP_soil_with_CN <- soil_with_CN %>% filter(type == "SPID")
C_soil_with_CN  <- soil_with_CN %>% filter(type == "CID")

# Merge CN into point tables
soil_SP_full <- soil_SP_raw %>%
  select(x, y, lbc_1, lb_ceq, p_h_2, ca, k, mg, mn, p, zn) %>%
  left_join(SP_soil_with_CN %>% select(x, y, c, n), by = c("x", "y"))

soil_C_full <- soil_C_raw %>%
  select(x, y, lbc_1, lb_ceq, p_h_2, ca, k, mg, mn, p, zn) %>%
  left_join(C_soil_with_CN %>% select(x, y, c, n), by = c("x", "y"))

soil_vars <- c("lbc_1","lb_ceq","p_h_2","ca","k","mg","mn","p","zn","c","n")

# Convert to sf in same CRS as raster
soil_sf_SP <- st_as_sf(soil_SP_full, coords = c("x","y"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs(covariate_stack))

soil_sf_C <- st_as_sf(soil_C_full, coords = c("x","y"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs(covariate_stack))

# Extract raster covariates directly at sample points
extract_covariates_to_sf <- function(sf_obj, rast_obj) {
  vals <- terra::extract(rast_obj, terra::vect(sf_obj))
  vals <- vals %>% dplyr::select(-ID)
  bind_cols(sf_obj, vals)
}

soil_sf_SP <- extract_covariates_to_sf(soil_sf_SP, covariate_stack)
soil_sf_C  <- extract_covariates_to_sf(soil_sf_C,  covariate_stack)

# Define covariates from raster names only
covariates <- names(covariate_stack)

# Keep only numeric covariates that exist in both sf tables
covariates <- covariates[covariates %in% names(soil_sf_SP)]
```

### Spatial Bootstrapping and Model Comparison

```{r, warning=FALSE}

# --- Spatial blocking function ---
generate_spatial_bootstrap_block <- function(sf_data,
                                             n_boot = 50,
                                             train_frac = 0.7,
                                             theRange = 50,
                                             n_folds = 5,
                                             seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)

  sb <- spatialBlock(
    speciesData = sf_data,
    theRange = theRange,
    k = n_folds,
    selection = "random",
    showBlocks = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  )

  sf_data$fold <- sb$foldID

  boot_list <- vector("list", n_boot)

  for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
    n_train_folds <- max(1, ceiling(train_frac * n_folds))
    train_folds <- sample(unique(sf_data$fold), n_train_folds)

    df <- sf_data %>%
      mutate(set = ifelse(fold %in% train_folds, "train", "test"))

    # guard against empty split
    if (sum(df$set == "train") == 0 || sum(df$set == "test") == 0) next

    boot_list[[i]] <- df
  }

  boot_list <- boot_list[!map_lgl(boot_list, is.null)]
  boot_list
}

# --- Safe R² function ---
safe_cor2 <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  
  if (length(x) < 3 || length(y) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  if (stats::var(x) == 0 || stats::var(y) == 0) return(0)
  
  suppressWarnings(cor(x, y)^2)
}
  #uses correlation with complete.obs to avoid NA issues... but I am not sure if this is the best way to handle it.

# --- Generate bootstraps ---
# Estimate an average variogram range first if you have it
# e.g., from your variogram fits:
# mean_range <- mean(fit_variograms$range, na.rm = TRUE)
# Otherwise start with 50 m as a field-scale approximation

boot_SP <- generate_spatial_bootstrap_block(soil_sf_SP,
                                            n_boot = 50,
                                            train_frac = 0.7,
                                            theRange = 50,
                                            n_folds = 5)

boot_C  <- generate_spatial_bootstrap_block(soil_sf_C,
                                            n_boot = 50,
                                            train_frac = 0.7,
                                            theRange = 50,
                                            n_folds = 5)


# --- Random Forest function ---
run_RF <- function(boot_list, covariates, soil_vars) {
  results <- list()

  for (var in soil_vars) {
    boot_results <- map(boot_list, function(df) {
      train_df <- st_drop_geometry(df %>% filter(set == "train")) %>%
        select(all_of(c(covariates, var))) %>%
        na.omit()

      test_df <- st_drop_geometry(df %>% filter(set == "test")) %>%
        select(all_of(c(covariates, var))) %>%
        na.omit()

      if (nrow(train_df) < 5 || nrow(test_df) < 5) {
        return(list(RMSE = NA_real_, R2 = NA_real_))
      }

      rf_model <- randomForest(
        x = train_df[, covariates, drop = FALSE],
        y = train_df[[var]],
        ntree = 500
      )

      pred <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_df[, covariates, drop = FALSE])

      list(
        model = rf_model,
        pred = pred,
        RMSE = sqrt(mean((pred - test_df[[var]])^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        R2 = safe_cor2(pred, test_df[[var]])
      )
    })

    results[[var]] <- boot_results
  }

  results
}
# --- Ordinary Kriging function with fallback ---
# --- Ordinary Kriging function with fallback (always returns R² even if only nugget) ---
run_OK_safe <- function(boot_list, soil_vars) {
  results <- list()

  for (var in soil_vars) {
    boot_results <- map(boot_list, function(df) {
      train_sf <- df %>% filter(set == "train")
      test_sf  <- df %>% filter(set == "test")

      train_sf <- train_sf %>% filter(is.finite(.data[[var]]))
      test_sf  <- test_sf  %>% filter(is.finite(.data[[var]]))

      if (nrow(train_sf) < 5 || nrow(test_sf) < 1) {
        return(list(RMSE = NA_real_, R2 = NA_real_))
      }

      train_vals <- train_sf[[var]]
      test_vals  <- test_sf[[var]]

      if (length(unique(train_vals)) <= 1) {
        pred <- rep(mean(train_vals, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(test_sf))
        return(list(
          pred = pred,
          RMSE = sqrt(mean((pred - test_vals)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
          R2 = safe_cor2(pred, test_vals)
        ))
      }

      vgm_model <- tryCatch({
        v_emp <- variogram(as.formula(paste(var, "~ 1")), train_sf)
        fit.variogram(
          v_emp,
          vgm(
            psill = stats::var(train_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
            model = "Exp",
            nugget = 0.1,
            range = max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3
          )
        )
      }, error = function(e) NULL)

      if (is.null(vgm_model)) {
        vgm_model <- vgm(
          psill = stats::var(train_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
          model = "Nug",
          nugget = 0.1
        )
      }

      ok_pred <- tryCatch({
        krige(as.formula(paste(var, "~ 1")), train_sf, test_sf, model = vgm_model)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)

      pred <- if (!is.null(ok_pred) && "var1.pred" %in% names(ok_pred)) {
        ok_pred$var1.pred
      } else {
        rep(mean(train_vals, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(test_sf))
      }

      list(
        pred = pred,
        RMSE = sqrt(mean((pred - test_vals)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        R2 = safe_cor2(pred, test_vals)
      )
    })

    results[[var]] <- boot_results
  }

  results
}


# --- Regression Kriging function with fallback ---
run_RK_safe <- function(boot_list, covariates, soil_vars) {
  results <- list()

  for (var in soil_vars) {
    boot_results <- map(boot_list, function(df) {
      train_sf <- df %>%
        filter(set == "train") %>%
        mutate(.row_id = row_number())

      test_sf <- df %>%
        filter(set == "test") %>%
        mutate(.row_id = row_number())

      train_df <- st_drop_geometry(train_sf) %>%
        select(.row_id, all_of(c(covariates, var))) %>%
        na.omit()

      test_df <- st_drop_geometry(test_sf) %>%
        select(.row_id, all_of(c(covariates, var))) %>%
        na.omit()

      if (nrow(train_df) < 5 || nrow(test_df) < 5) {
        return(list(RMSE = NA_real_, R2 = NA_real_))
      }

      train_sf2 <- train_sf %>% filter(.row_id %in% train_df$.row_id)
      test_sf2  <- test_sf  %>% filter(.row_id %in% test_df$.row_id)

      rf_model <- randomForest(
        x = train_df[, covariates, drop = FALSE],
        y = train_df[[var]],
        ntree = 500
      )

      trend_train <- predict(rf_model, newdata = train_df[, covariates, drop = FALSE])
      trend_test  <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_df[, covariates, drop = FALSE])

      residuals_train <- train_df[[var]] - trend_train
      train_res_sf <- train_sf2 %>% mutate(residuals = residuals_train)

      vgm_model <- tryCatch({
        v_emp <- variogram(residuals ~ 1, train_res_sf)
        fit.variogram(
          v_emp,
          vgm(
            psill = stats::var(residuals_train, na.rm = TRUE),
            model = "Exp",
            nugget = 0.1,
            range = max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3
          )
        )
      }, error = function(e) NULL)

      if (is.null(vgm_model)) {
        vgm_model <- vgm(
          psill = stats::var(residuals_train, na.rm = TRUE),
          model = "Nug",
          nugget = 0.1
        )
      }

      rk_pred <- tryCatch({
        krige(residuals ~ 1, train_res_sf, test_sf2, model = vgm_model)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)

      resid_test <- if (!is.null(rk_pred) && "var1.pred" %in% names(rk_pred)) {
        rk_pred$var1.pred
      } else {
        rep(0, nrow(test_sf2))
      }

      final_pred <- trend_test + resid_test

      list(
        RMSE = sqrt(mean((final_pred - test_df[[var]])^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        R2 = safe_cor2(final_pred, test_df[[var]])
      )
    })

    results[[var]] <- boot_results
  }

  results
}

# --- Run all methods ---
RF_results_SP <- run_RF(boot_SP, covariates, soil_vars)
RF_results_C  <- run_RF(boot_C, covariates, soil_vars)
OK_results_SP <- run_OK_safe(boot_SP, soil_vars)
OK_results_C  <- run_OK_safe(boot_C, soil_vars)
RK_results_SP <- run_RK_safe(boot_SP, covariates, soil_vars)
RK_results_C  <- run_RK_safe(boot_C, covariates, soil_vars)

# --- Function to extract metrics ---
extract_metrics <- function(results_list, dataset_name){
  map_dfr(names(results_list), function(var){
    res <- results_list[[var]]
    tibble(variable=var, RMSE=map_dbl(res,"RMSE"), R2=map_dbl(res,"R2"))
  }) %>% mutate(dataset=dataset_name)
}
rf_metrics_all <- bind_rows(extract_metrics(RF_results_SP, "SP"),
                            extract_metrics(RF_results_C, "C"))
ok_metrics_all <- bind_rows(extract_metrics(OK_results_SP, "SP"),
                            extract_metrics(OK_results_C, "C"))
rk_metrics_all <- bind_rows(extract_metrics(RK_results_SP, "SP"),
                            extract_metrics(RK_results_C, "C"))

# --- Combine all for plotting ---
combined_metrics <- bind_rows(rf_metrics_all %>% mutate(method="RF"),
                              ok_metrics_all %>% mutate(method="OK"),
                              rk_metrics_all %>% mutate(method="RK")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c(RMSE,R2), names_to="metric", values_to="value")

# --- Plot ---

ggplot(combined_metrics, aes(x=variable, y=value, fill=dataset)) +
  geom_violin(trim=FALSE, alpha=0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1, position=position_dodge(width=0.9), outlier.shape=NA) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
  labs(title="Distribution of RMSE and R² across nutrients - All Methods",
       x="Nutrient", y="Value") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set2") +
  facet_grid(metric~method, scales="free_y")
```

```{r}
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

extract_metrics_iter <- function(results_list, dataset_name, method_name) {
  map_dfr(names(results_list), function(var) {
    res <- results_list[[var]]
    tibble(
      variable = var,
      iteration = seq_along(res),
      RMSE = map_dbl(res, ~ .x$RMSE %||% NA_real_),
      R2   = map_dbl(res, ~ .x$R2   %||% NA_real_)
    )
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = dataset_name,
      method = method_name
    )
}

metrics_all <- bind_rows(
  extract_metrics_iter(RF_results_SP, "SP", "RF"),
  extract_metrics_iter(RF_results_C,  "C",  "RF"),
  extract_metrics_iter(OK_results_SP, "SP", "OK"),
  extract_metrics_iter(OK_results_C,  "C",  "OK"),
  extract_metrics_iter(RK_results_SP, "SP", "RK"),
  extract_metrics_iter(RK_results_C,  "C",  "RK")
)


select_best_iterations <- function(metrics_tbl, top_frac = 0.25, n_fallback = 5) {
  
  metrics_tbl %>%
    filter(is.finite(RMSE), is.finite(R2)) %>%
    group_by(dataset, variable, method) %>%
    mutate(
      r2_cut   = quantile(R2, probs = 1 - top_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
      rmse_cut = quantile(RMSE, probs = top_frac, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      keep = R2 >= r2_cut & RMSE <= rmse_cut
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rmse_score = ifelse(
        max(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE) == min(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
        1,
        (max(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE) - RMSE) /
          (max(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE) - min(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE))
      ),
      r2_score = ifelse(
        max(R2, na.rm = TRUE) == min(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
        1,
        (R2 - min(R2, na.rm = TRUE)) /
          (max(R2, na.rm = TRUE) - min(R2, na.rm = TRUE))
      ),
      score = 0.5 * rmse_score + 0.5 * r2_score
    ) %>%
    arrange(dataset, variable, method, desc(score)) %>%
    group_by(dataset, variable, method) %>%
    mutate(
      keep = ifelse(sum(keep, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 & row_number() <= n_fallback, TRUE, keep)
    ) %>%
    filter(keep) %>%
    mutate(
      weight = score / sum(score, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

selected_iters <- select_best_iterations(metrics_all, top_frac = 0.25, n_fallback = 5)
covariates_use <- intersect(covariates, names(covariate_stack))
build_final_method_ensemble <- function(dataset_name, method_name, variable_name,
                                        selected_iters, boot_SP, boot_C,
                                        covariates_use, covariate_stack) {
  
  boot_list <- switch(
    dataset_name,
    "SP" = boot_SP,
    "C"  = boot_C,
    stop("dataset_name must be 'SP' or 'C'")
  )
  
  sel <- selected_iters %>%
    filter(dataset == dataset_name,
           method == method_name,
           variable == variable_name)
  
  if (nrow(sel) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  template_rast <- covariate_stack[[1]]
  ensemble_rast <- NULL
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sel))) {
    iter_id <- sel$iteration[i]
    w <- sel$weight[i]
    df_boot <- boot_list[[iter_id]]
    r_pred <- NULL
    
    if (method_name == "RF") {
      train_df <- st_drop_geometry(df_boot %>% filter(set == "train")) %>%
        select(all_of(c(covariates_use, variable_name))) %>%
        na.omit()
      
      if (nrow(train_df) >= 5) {
        rf_model <- randomForest(
          x = train_df[, covariates_use, drop = FALSE],
          y = train_df[[variable_name]],
          ntree = 500
        )
        
        r_pred <- terra::predict(
          covariate_stack[[covariates_use]],
          rf_model,
          fun = function(model, data) {
            data <- as.data.frame(data)
            predict(model, newdata = data)
          },
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      }
    }
    
    if (method_name == "OK") {
      train_sf <- df_boot %>%
        filter(set == "train", is.finite(.data[[variable_name]]))
      
      vals <- train_sf[[variable_name]]
      
      if (nrow(train_sf) >= 5 && length(unique(vals)) > 1) {
        vgm_model <- tryCatch({
          v_emp <- variogram(as.formula(paste(variable_name, "~ 1")), train_sf)
          fit.variogram(
            v_emp,
            vgm(
              psill = stats::var(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
              model = "Exp",
              nugget = 0.1,
              range = max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3
            )
          )
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (is.null(vgm_model)) {
          vgm_model <- vgm(
            psill = stats::var(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
            model = "Nug",
            nugget = 0.1
          )
        }
        
        grid_pts <- terra::as.points(template_rast, values = FALSE)
        grid_sf  <- sf::st_as_sf(grid_pts)
        
        ok_pred <- tryCatch({
          krige(as.formula(paste(variable_name, "~ 1")), train_sf, grid_sf, model = vgm_model)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(ok_pred) && "var1.pred" %in% names(ok_pred)) {
          pred_vect <- terra::vect(ok_pred)
          r_pred <- terra::rasterize(pred_vect, template_rast, field = "var1.pred")
        }
      }
    }
    
    if (method_name == "RK") {
      train_sf <- df_boot %>%
        filter(set == "train") %>%
        mutate(.row_id = row_number())
      
      train_df <- st_drop_geometry(train_sf) %>%
        select(.row_id, all_of(c(covariates_use, variable_name))) %>%
        na.omit()
      
      if (nrow(train_df) >= 5) {
        train_sf2 <- train_sf %>% filter(.row_id %in% train_df$.row_id)
        
        rf_model <- randomForest(
          x = train_df[, covariates_use, drop = FALSE],
          y = train_df[[variable_name]],
          ntree = 500
        )
        
        trend_train <- predict(rf_model, newdata = train_df[, covariates_use, drop = FALSE])
        residuals_train <- train_df[[variable_name]] - trend_train
        
        trend_rast <- terra::predict(
          covariate_stack[[covariates_use]],
          rf_model,
          fun = function(model, data) {
            data <- as.data.frame(data)
            predict(model, newdata = data)
          },
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
        
        train_res_sf <- train_sf2 %>% mutate(residuals = residuals_train)
        
        vgm_model <- tryCatch({
          v_emp <- variogram(residuals ~ 1, train_res_sf)
          fit.variogram(
            v_emp,
            vgm(
              psill = stats::var(residuals_train, na.rm = TRUE),
              model = "Exp",
              nugget = 0.1,
              range = max(v_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3
            )
          )
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (is.null(vgm_model)) {
          vgm_model <- vgm(
            psill = stats::var(residuals_train, na.rm = TRUE),
            model = "Nug",
            nugget = 0.1
          )
        }
        
        grid_pts <- terra::as.points(template_rast, values = FALSE)
        grid_sf  <- sf::st_as_sf(grid_pts)
        
        rk_resid <- tryCatch({
          krige(residuals ~ 1, train_res_sf, grid_sf, model = vgm_model)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(rk_resid) && "var1.pred" %in% names(rk_resid)) {
          resid_vect <- terra::vect(rk_resid)
          resid_rast <- terra::rasterize(resid_vect, template_rast, field = "var1.pred")
        } else {
          resid_rast <- trend_rast * 0
        }
        
        r_pred <- trend_rast + resid_rast
      }
    }
    
    if (!is.null(r_pred)) {
      ensemble_rast <- if (is.null(ensemble_rast)) r_pred * w else ensemble_rast + (r_pred * w)
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(ensemble_rast)) {
    names(ensemble_rast) <- paste(dataset_name, method_name, variable_name, "ensemble", sep = "_")
  }
  
  ensemble_rast
}
final_ensemble_rasters <- list()

for (ds in c("SP", "C")) {
  final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]] <- list()
  
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]] <- list()
    
    for (v in soil_vars) {
      cat("Building final ensemble:", ds, meth, v, "\n")
      
      final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]] <- build_final_method_ensemble(
        dataset_name = ds,
        method_name = meth,
        variable_name = v,
        selected_iters = selected_iters,
        boot_SP = boot_SP,
        boot_C = boot_C,
        covariates_use = covariates_use,
        covariate_stack = covariate_stack
      )
    }
  }
}


#plot all:
par(mfrow = c(3, 3))

for (ds in names(final_ensemble_rasters)) {
  for (meth in names(final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]])) {
    for (v in names(final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]])) {
      r <- final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]]
      if (!is.null(r)) {
        plot(r, main = paste(ds, meth, v))
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
        paste0(ds, "_", meth, "_", v, "_ensemble.tif")
      )
      
      terra::writeRaster(r_obj, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
create_single_nutrient_zones <- function(r, var_name, k = 3, seed = 123, sample_n = 10000) {
  if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
  
  vals <- terra::values(r, na.rm = FALSE, mat = FALSE)
  ok <- is.finite(vals)
  
  if (sum(ok) < k) return(NULL)
  
  v <- vals[ok]
  
  # skip constant rasters
  if (length(unique(v)) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  k_use <- min(k, length(unique(v)))
  if (k_use < 2) return(NULL)
  
  # fit kmeans on a sample, not all pixels
  set.seed(seed)
  if (length(v) > sample_n) {
    v_fit <- sample(v, sample_n)
  } else {
    v_fit <- v
  }
  
  km <- kmeans(matrix(v_fit, ncol = 1), centers = k_use, nstart = 25)
  
  # order clusters low -> high so zone 1 is always low
  center_order <- order(km$centers[, 1])
  ordered_centers <- km$centers[center_order, 1]
  
  # assign every valid pixel to nearest ordered center
  dmat <- sapply(seq_along(ordered_centers), function(j) {
    (v - ordered_centers[j])^2
  })
  dmat <- as.matrix(dmat)
  if (is.vector(dmat)) dmat <- matrix(dmat, ncol = 1)
  
  zone_id <- max.col(-dmat, ties.method = "first")
  
  zone_vals <- rep(NA_integer_, length(vals))
  zone_vals[ok] <- zone_id
  
  zone_r <- r
  terra::values(zone_r) <- zone_vals
  names(zone_r) <- paste0(var_name, "_zones")
  
  list(
    raster = zone_r,
    centers = ordered_centers,
    model = km
  )
}

single_nutrient_zones <- list()

for (ds in c("SP", "C")) {

        NULL
      })

plot_all_single_nutrient_zones <- function(zone_list, soil_vars,
                                           datasets = c("SP", "C"),
                                           methods = c("RF", "OK", "RK"),
                                           ncol = 3, nrow = 3) {
  
  maps_per_page <- ncol * nrow
  
  plot_items <- list()
  
  for (ds in datasets) {
    for (meth in methods) {
      for (v in soil_vars) {
        z <- zone_list[[ds]][[meth]][[v]]
        if (!is.null(z) && !is.null(z$raster)) {
          plot_items[[length(plot_items) + 1]] <- list(
            raster = z$raster,
            title = paste(ds, meth, v)
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (length(plot_items) == 0) {
    message("No zone rasters available to plot.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(old_par))
  
  for (i in seq(1, length(plot_items), by = maps_per_page)) {
    idx <- i:min(i + maps_per_page - 1, length(plot_items))
    
    par(mfrow = c(nrow, ncol), mar = c(2, 2, 3, 4))
    
    for (j in idx) {
      plot(plot_items[[j]]$raster, main = plot_items[[j]]$title)
    }
  }
}

  methods = c("RF", "OK", "RK"),
  ncol = 3,
  nrow = 3
)
```

```{r}
#umap multinutrient:
build_method_stack <- function(final_ensemble_rasters, dataset_name, method_name, soil_vars) {
  rast_list <- list()
  
  for (v in soil_vars) {
    r <- final_ensemble_rasters[[dataset_name]][[method_name]][[v]]
    if (!is.null(r)) rast_list[[v]] <- r
  }
  
  if (length(rast_list) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  out <- rast(rast_list)
  names(out) <- names(rast_list)
  out
}
filter_stack_by_completeness <- function(r_stack, max_na_prop = 0.4) {
  keep <- sapply(names(r_stack), function(nm) {
    vals <- terra::values(r_stack[[nm]], mat = FALSE)
    mean(is.na(vals)) <= max_na_prop
  })
  
  r_stack[[names(r_stack)[keep]]]
}

mask_to_common_support <- function(r_stack) {
  valid_sum <- sum(!is.na(r_stack))
  common_mask <- valid_sum == nlyr(r_stack)
  terra::mask(r_stack, common_mask, maskvalues = 0)
}
build_method_stack <- function(final_ensemble_rasters, dataset_name, method_name, soil_vars) {
  rast_list <- list()
  
  for (v in soil_vars) {
    r <- final_ensemble_rasters[[dataset_name]][[method_name]][[v]]
    if (!is.null(r)) {
      vals <- terra::values(r, mat = FALSE)
      if (sum(!is.na(vals)) > 0) {
        rast_list[[v]] <- r
      } else {
        message("Dropping ", dataset_name, " ", method_name, " ", v, " because it has 0 valid cells.")
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (length(rast_list) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  out <- terra::rast(rast_list)
  names(out) <- names(rast_list)
  out
}
sample_raster_pixels <- function(r_stack, n = 20000, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  samp <- terra::spatSample(
    r_stack,
    size = n,
    method = "random",
    na.rm = TRUE,
    as.df = TRUE,
    warn = FALSE
  )
  
  samp <- as.data.frame(samp)
  
  # keep only actual raster layer columns
  samp <- samp[, names(r_stack), drop = FALSE]
  
  # remove incomplete rows
  samp <- samp[complete.cases(samp), , drop = FALSE]
  
  samp
}

fit_sample_kmeans_zones <- function(sample_df, k = 4, seed = 123) {
  sample_df <- as.data.frame(sample_df)
  
  if (nrow(sample_df) == 0) {
    stop("No sampled pixels available after NA filtering.")
  }
  
  # keep numeric columns only
  sample_df <- sample_df[, vapply(sample_df, is.numeric, logical(1)), drop = FALSE]
  
  if (ncol(sample_df) == 0) {
    stop("No numeric raster layers available for clustering.")
  }
  
  # drop zero-variance columns
  keep <- vapply(sample_df, function(x) {
    sx <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    is.finite(sx) && sx > 0
  }, logical(1))
  
  sample_df <- sample_df[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  
  if (ncol(sample_df) == 0) {
    stop("All sampled raster layers had zero variance.")
  }
  
  # if too few rows, reduce k
  k_use <- min(k, nrow(sample_df))
  if (k_use < 2) {
    stop("Too few sampled pixels to create 2 or more clusters.")
  }
  
  x <- scale(sample_df)
  
  set.seed(seed)
  km <- kmeans(x, centers = k_use, nstart = 25)
  
  list(
    model = km,
    centers = km$centers,
    scale_center = attr(x, "scaled:center"),
    scale_scale  = attr(x, "scaled:scale"),
    kept_names = colnames(sample_df),
    sample_scaled = x,
    sample_cluster = km$cluster
  )
}

assign_raster_to_centroids <- function(r_stack, zone_fit, filename = NULL, overwrite = TRUE) {
  
  centers <- as.matrix(zone_fit$centers)
  scale_center <- zone_fit$scale_center
  scale_scale  <- zone_fit$scale_scale
  
  zone_fun <- function(v) {
    if (is.null(dim(v))) {
      v <- matrix(v, ncol = length(scale_center), byrow = TRUE)
    } else {
      v <- as.matrix(v)
    }
    
    out <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(v))
    ok <- complete.cases(v)
    if (!any(ok)) return(out)
    
    x <- v[ok, , drop = FALSE]
    x_scaled <- sweep(x, 2, scale_center, "-")
    x_scaled <- sweep(x_scaled, 2, scale_scale, "/")
    
    dmat <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(centers)), function(j) {
      rowSums((x_scaled - matrix(
        centers[j, ],
        nrow = nrow(x_scaled),
        ncol = ncol(x_scaled),
        byrow = TRUE
      ))^2)
    }, FUN.VALUE = numeric(nrow(x_scaled)))
    
    dmat <- as.matrix(dmat)
    if (nrow(dmat) != nrow(x_scaled)) dmat <- t(dmat)
    
    out[ok] <- max.col(-dmat, ties.method = "first")
    out
  }
  
  if (is.null(filename)) {
    z <- terra::app(
      r_stack,
      fun = zone_fun
    )
  } else {
    z <- terra::app(
      r_stack,
      fun = zone_fun,
      filename = filename,
      overwrite = overwrite,
      wopt = list(datatype = "INT2S")
    )
  }
  
  names(z) <- "management_zone"
  z
}

management_zone_rasters <- list()

for (ds in c("SP", "C")) {
  management_zone_rasters[[ds]] <- list()
  
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    cat("Creating zones for", ds, meth, "\n")
    
    management_zone_rasters[[ds]][[meth]] <- tryCatch({
      r_stack <- build_method_stack(final_ensemble_rasters, ds, meth, soil_vars)
      if (is.null(r_stack)) stop("No usable layers in stack.")
      
      r_stack <- filter_stack_by_completeness(r_stack, max_na_prop = 0.4)
      if (is.null(r_stack) || terra::nlyr(r_stack) < 2) {
        stop("Fewer than 2 usable layers after completeness filtering.")
      }
      
      r_stack <- mask_to_common_support(r_stack)
      
      samp <- sample_raster_pixels(r_stack, n = 10000, seed = 123)
      if (nrow(samp) < 10) {
        stop("Too few complete sampled pixels after filtering.")
      }
      
      fit <- fit_sample_kmeans_zones(samp, k = 4, seed = 123)
      r_stack_use <- r_stack[[fit$kept_names]]
      
      assign_raster_to_centroids(
        r_stack = r_stack_use,
        zone_fit = fit
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Failed for ", ds, " ", meth, ": ", e$message)
      NULL
    })
  }
}
```

```{r}
validate_zone_variable <- function(df, zone_col, var_col) {
  dat <- df %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(zone_col, var_col))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[zone_col]]), !is.na(.data[[var_col]]))
  
  if (nrow(dat) < 5 || dplyr::n_distinct(dat[[zone_col]]) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      zone = zone_col,
      variable = var_col,
      n = nrow(dat),
      n_zones = dplyr::n_distinct(dat[[zone_col]]),
      p_value = NA_real_,
      statistic = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  kw <- kruskal.test(dat[[var_col]] ~ as.factor(dat[[zone_col]]))
  
  tibble(
    zone = zone_col,
    variable = var_col,
    n = nrow(dat),
    n_zones = dplyr::n_distinct(dat[[zone_col]]),
    p_value = kw$p.value,
    statistic = as.numeric(kw$statistic)
  )
}
```

```{r}
zone_r2 <- function(df, zone_col, value_col) {
  dat <- df %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(c(zone_col, value_col))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[zone_col]]), !is.na(.data[[value_col]]))
  
  if (nrow(dat) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(dat[[zone_col]]) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  
  y <- dat[[value_col]]
  grand_mean <- mean(y)
  
  ss_total <- sum((y - grand_mean)^2)
  
  zone_means <- dat %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[zone_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(zone_mean = mean(.data[[value_col]]), .groups = "drop")
  
  dat2 <- dat %>%
    dplyr::left_join(zone_means, by = setNames(zone_col, zone_col))
  
  ss_within <- sum((dat2[[value_col]] - dat2$zone_mean)^2)
  
  1 - (ss_within / ss_total)
}

zone_cv_summary <- function(df, zone_col, value_col) {
  df %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(c(zone_col, value_col))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[zone_col]]), !is.na(.data[[value_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[zone_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n = dplyr::n(),
      mean = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      cv = 100 * sd / mean,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
zone_cv_overall <- function(df, zone_col, value_col) {
  zcv <- zone_cv_summary(df, zone_col, value_col)
  
  if (nrow(zcv) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      mean_cv = NA_real_,
      median_cv = NA_real_,
      weighted_mean_cv = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  tibble(
    mean_cv = mean(zcv$cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_cv = median(zcv$cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_mean_cv = weighted.mean(zcv$cv, w = zcv$n, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

})

variance_cv_summary_by_method <- zone_variance_cv_results2 %>%
  group_by(dataset, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n_variables = n(),
    mean_zone_r2 = mean(zone_r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_zone_r2 = median(zone_r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_weighted_cv = mean(weighted_mean_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_weighted_cv = median(weighted_mean_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(dataset, desc(mean_zone_r2), mean_weighted_cv)

variance_cv_summary_by_method

variance_cv_nutrient_table <- zone_variance_cv_results2 %>%
  arrange(dataset, method, desc(zone_r2), weighted_mean_cv)

variance_cv_nutrient_table

single_val_map <- c(
  ca = "Ca_0_15",
  k = "K_0_15",
  mg = "Mg_0_15",
  mn = "Mn_0_15",
  p = "P_0_15",
  zn = "Zn_0_15",
  p_h_2 = "pH.2_0_15",
  lbc_1 = "LBC.1_0_15",
  lb_ceq = "LBCeq_0_15",
  c = "C_pct_0_15",
  n = "N_pct_0_15"
)

single_zone_variance_cv <- list()

for (ds in c("SP", "C")) {
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    for (nut in names(single_val_map)) {
      
      z_obj <- single_nutrient_zones[[ds]][[meth]][[nut]]
      if (is.null(z_obj)) next
      
      zone_vals <- terra::extract(z_obj$raster, terra::vect(hz_0_15_sf))
      
      dat <- hz_0_15_sf %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        mutate(zone_id = zone_vals[, 2]) %>%
        filter(!is.na(zone_id))
      
      vv <- single_val_map[[nut]]
      
      single_zone_variance_cv[[paste(ds, meth, nut, sep = "_")]] <- tibble(
        dataset = ds,
        method = meth,
        nutrient = nut,
        value_col = vv,
        zone_r2 = zone_r2(dat, "zone_id", vv),
        mean_cv = zone_cv_overall(dat, "zone_id", vv)$mean_cv,
        median_cv = zone_cv_overall(dat, "zone_id", vv)$median_cv,
        weighted_mean_cv = zone_cv_overall(dat, "zone_id", vv)$weighted_mean_cv
      )
    }
  }
}

single_zone_variance_cv_results <- bind_rows(single_zone_variance_cv)
single_zone_variance_cv_results

single_zone_variance_cv_summary <- single_zone_variance_cv_results %>%
  group_by(dataset, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n_variables = n(),
    mean_zone_r2 = mean(zone_r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_zone_r2 = median(zone_r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_weighted_cv = mean(weighted_mean_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_weighted_cv = median(weighted_mean_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(dataset, desc(mean_zone_r2), mean_weighted_cv)

single_zone_variance_cv_summary

single_zone_variance_cv_summary <- single_zone_variance_cv_summary %>%
  mutate(
    r2_rank = rank(-mean_zone_r2, ties.method = "average"),
    cv_rank = rank(mean_weighted_cv, ties.method = "average"),
    overall_rank_score = (r2_rank + cv_rank) / 2
  ) %>%
  arrange(overall_rank_score)

single_zone_variance_cv_summary

# Zone-based variance analysis indicated that multinutrient management zones explained a modest but meaningful proportion of independent 0–15 cm validation variability. In the single-point dataset, regression kriging produced the strongest overall multinutrient zone performance, whereas in the composite dataset, random forest produced the strongest overall performance, with regression kriging close behind. Across both datasets, the best-performing zones most consistently captured variation in phosphorus, manganese, calcium, and LBC-related properties, while potassium, magnesium, and pH showed weaker zone structure. Within-zone CV values indicated that some properties remained relatively heterogeneous within zones, particularly Zn and LBCeq, suggesting that even statistically supported zones may still contain substantial internal variability.
```
